answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> False Sects Question ID: 51497 Country: Pakistan Title: Prayer behind Ibadi Imam in Jamat? Question: I am living in Oman where majority of people are belong to the Ibadi sect of Muslim. My Question is: is it OK to pray Namaz behind Ibadi imam or I pray my own individual Namaz? Answer ID: 51497 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 630/537/H=04/1435) The Ibadi sect which exists in Oman Sultanate is a branch of Khawarij sect which is out of the fold of Islam. Salah behind the imam of this belief is invalid. (Ahsanul Fatawa 1:198) So, you should perform salah individually. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
